notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP fetch only (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome110), never escalated - site is server-rendered (Vue SSR), robots.txt has no blanket Disallow and no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai rules, only specific query-param disallows which were not used. TREE: union of (1) full server-rendered mega-menu (9 rail items x their content-pane groups, all read from homepage HTML) and (2) sitemap1.xml (6404 URLs, filtered to /collections/ and /pages/ paths, grepped for textile/storage keyword stems) to catch base-slug categories not surfaced in the reduced mega-menu 'Meer >' lists. Brand-filtered collection variants (e.g. vandyck-badjas, aquanova-wasmanden) and color/material attribute variants (e.g. dekbedovertrek-blauw) were excluded as non-category filter pages, not genuine nav nodes. QTY: exact integer read from the server-rendered 'N artikelen' counter on each category page (present in raw HTML before hydration, confirmed against several pages). EXCLUDED (bad-slug/duplicate-content, confirmed by comparing product count AND first-N product names byte-for-byte before excluding, per brief's silent-wrong-number warning): stoelkussen (921, identical listing to sierkussens - not a real chair-cushion filter), binnenkleed (2656, near-identical listing to vloerkleden), binnenkussen (1051, superset/umbrella of sierkussens, not nav-linked), buiten-vloerkleed (35, identical listing to buitenkleed), speelkleed and kinderkleed (3, both identical listing to kindervloerkleed), opbergdoos/opbergkist/opbergkratje (all three identical 822-count listing led by jewelry-box products, not genuinely filtered by box/chest/crate type - could not get a reliable distinct qty per subtype so all three dropped), opbergen (1778, broad umbrella superset of organizen-bewaren, not nav-linked), badkameropberger (2751, broad umbrella not nav-linked, overlaps specific bathroom categories), textiel (1276, contaminated - first-page results included furniture e.g. 'Hartman Emma Lounge Bed', not a coherent category), warmtedeken (11, actually heated scarves 'Warmtesjaal' - apparel/electrical, not home textile), gordijn (0 products, not linked anywhere in nav, 'gordijnen' 404s - treated as stale/inactive page not a live category). kinderdekbed and kinderhoofdkussen ARE explicitly nav-linked (Baby & kids > Kinderbeddengoed) but currently show 0 products - kept with qty=0 per zero-product-category rule since evidenced by the site's own counter. EXCLUDED as out-of-scope categories entirely (Furniture/Lighting/Kitchen&Dining/Wall Decor/Decorative Accessories/apparel/pet per rule boundaries): Meubels rail, Verlichting rail, all Tuinmeubelen/Zonwering items, Muurdecoratie group (mirrors/clocks/wall shelves/posters/wallpaper), Afvalemmers group, Huisdierbenodigdheden, cookware/tableware/knives under Koken&tafelen, Kindermeubels, toiletaccessoires (toilet brushes/holders - hardware not storage containers), tandenborstelhouder. Parent category URLs were dropped wherever specific children existed (e.g. 'Opbergers' 892-item parent dropped in favor of its named children Voorraadpot/Opbergmand/Schoenenrek/etc).
